data.description: Use natural language to search for files, no need to remember file names
data.descriptionEn: Use natural language to search for files, no need to remember file names
data.descriptionZh: 用自然语言描述就能找到文件，无需记住文件名
data.readme:
· Locate files by name, type, size, time, or tags.
· View file size, modification time, location, etc.
· Search only locates files; it will not move, delete, or rename them directly
data.readmeEn:
· Locate files by name, type, size, time, or tags.
· View file size, modification time, location, etc.
· Search only locates files; it will not move, delete, or rename them directly
data.readmeZh:
· 帮你按文件名、类型、大小、时间或标签查找文件
· 可以查看文件大小、修改时间、所在位置等信息
· 搜索只帮你定位文件，不会直接移动、删除或改名
